lines.zh: 我在平原上慢慢走，像一块移动的饼干。
lines.en: I walk the plains slowly, like a moving cookie.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩过草地，留下圆圆的印。
lines.en: My hooves press round prints into the grass.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑块，是烤出来的颜色。
lines.en: My patches have the color of something baked.

lines.zh: 走快一点，碎屑会掉一路。
lines.en: Walk faster and crumbs trail along behind me.

lines.zh: 别走太近，我转弯很慢。
lines.en: Do not walk too close; I turn very slowly.

lines.zh: 我跟着牛群，走成一条直线。
lines.en: I follow the herd and keep a straight line.

lines.zh: 阳光把我的背晒得更焦了。
lines.en: The sun bakes my back a shade darker.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，肚子沉甸甸的。
lines.en: I sway with each step, my belly heavy.

lines.zh: 草原尽头有片水，我正走过去。
lines.en: There is water past the plains, and I am going.

lines.zh: 我的影子圆圆的，像块饼。
lines.en: My shadow is round like a flat biscuit.

lines.zh: 四只蹄子轮流落地，很稳。
lines.en: Four hooves take turns landing, quite steadily.

lines.zh: 小草被我一啃，短了一截。
lines.en: One bite from me shortens the grass.

lines.zh: 我身上有烤饼的香味。
lines.en: I smell of fresh-baked cookies.

lines.zh: 你家牧场在那边吗？我闻到了草。
lines.en: Is your pasture that way? I smell grass.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，走得很直。
lines.en: I walk along the fence, straight as a line.

lines.zh: 前面有片苜蓿，我加快了一点。
lines.en: Clover ahead; I speed up a little.

lines.zh: 我站着反刍，嘴角挂着草屑。
lines.en: I stand chewing cud with grass on my lip.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我身上有股甜味。
lines.en: When the wind blows, I smell faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩了一下，赶走两只苍蝇。
lines.en: One flick of my tail chases off two flies.

lines.zh: 我低头看看自己，颜色真像点心。
lines.en: I look down at myself; I do resemble a pastry.

lines.zh: 耳朵转了个方向，听见了蜜蜂。
lines.en: One ear turns; I heard a bee go past.

lines.zh: 我在想，草和饼干哪个更好吃。
lines.en: I wonder which is better, grass or biscuits.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的斑块晒得暖烘烘。
lines.en: The sun warms all my darker patches.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，喷出一点草沫。
lines.en: I snort and spray a little grass froth.

lines.zh: 十点生命不算多，我得小心。
lines.en: Ten health is not much; I should be careful.

lines.zh: 那块石头看起来可以蹭痒。
lines.en: That stone looks good for scratching an itch.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，快要睡着了。
lines.en: I blink slowly and am close to sleeping.

lines.zh: 远处有牛叫，我也应了一声。
lines.en: A cow calls in the distance, so I answer.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔背上的斑点。
lines.en: I lick the spots along my back.

lines.zh: 我嚼了很久，其实早咽下去了。
lines.en: I have chewed a long while, and swallowed already.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子顶在篱笆上，发呆。
lines.en: I rest my nose on the fence and stare.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我换个方向站。
lines.en: The sun has moved, so I turn to face it.

lines.zh: 你盯着我看，是不是饿了？
lines.en: Are you staring at me because you are hungry?

lines.zh: 我不是真的饼干，别咬我。
lines.en: I am not an actual cookie, so do not bite me.

lines.zh: 你的手上有麦子的味道。
lines.en: Your hands carry the smell of wheat.

lines.zh: 你手里那块像饼干，又不像。
lines.en: The thing in your hand looks like a cookie. Almost.

lines.zh: 你笑了，是因为我的颜色吗？
lines.en: Are you smiling because of my color?

lines.zh: 我眼睛不大，但看得很清楚。
lines.en: My eyes are small, but they see clearly.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我会先退一步。
lines.en: If you reach out, I will step back first.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我不认识。
lines.en: Your scent is one I do not recognize.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把额头给你看。
lines.en: I lower my head and show you my forehead.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了泥，很像我踩的。
lines.en: Your boots are muddy, much like my hooves.

lines.zh: 别站在我后面，我看不见。
lines.en: Do not stand behind me; I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 我们互相看了很久，都没动。
lines.en: We have watched each other a long while, unmoving.

lines.zh: 你打在我背上，我往前一冲。
lines.en: You hit my back, and I lurch forward.

lines.zh: 我哞了一声，声音都抖了。
lines.en: I moo, and the sound comes out shaky.

lines.zh: 十点生命，经不起几下。
lines.en: Ten health does not survive many blows.

lines.zh: 我不是饼干，打碎了不会掉渣。
lines.en: I am not a cookie; breaking me drops no crumbs.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想跑回牛群里。
lines.en: That blow makes me want to rejoin the herd.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，但也会痛。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but it still feels pain.

lines.zh: 伤口在肋下，呼吸有点疼。
lines.en: The wound is under my ribs; breathing hurts.

lines.zh: 你砍到的是毛，不是肉。
lines.en: What you cut was hair, not meat.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，蹄子踩空了。
lines.en: I backed two steps and missed my footing.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把背朝向你。
lines.en: I lower my head and turn my back to you.

lines.zh: 你举着小麦，我的蹄子就自己动了。
lines.en: You hold up wheat and my hooves move on their own.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，只为了那口草。
lines.en: I trail behind you only for that mouthful of grass.

lines.zh: 那股麦香，比什么都管用。
lines.en: That wheat smell works better than anything else.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我腿短。
lines.en: Do not walk so fast; my legs are short.

lines.zh: 我鼻子凑过去，只是闻，不抢。
lines.en: I bring my nose close to sniff, not to grab.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，是饼干吗？
lines.en: That thing in your hand — a cookie?

lines.zh: 我这辈子就认这一口。
lines.en: This one bite is all I have ever wanted.

lines.zh: 你把草放低点，我够得着。
lines.en: Lower the grass a bit so I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我走三步停一下，等你回头。
lines.en: I take three steps, pause, and wait for you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我闻着就安心。
lines.en: Whatever you hold, its smell puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，走进了陌生的草地。
lines.en: I followed you into grass I have never seen.

lines.zh: 别拿空手骗我，我认得出。
lines.en: Do not fool me with empty hands; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我的嘴角已经在流口水了。
lines.en: There is already drool at the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停，我们很有默契。
lines.en: You stop, I stop; we understand each other.

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，比饼还香。
lines.en: That grass in your hand smells better than cake.

lines.zh: 我跟着草走，走到哪都行。
lines.en: I follow the grass wherever it goes.

lines.zh: 你撞到我肚子，软软的。
lines.en: You bumped into my belly, and it is soft.

lines.zh: 让一让，我转身要占很大地方。
lines.en: Make room; turning around takes a lot of space.

lines.zh: 我被挤到一边，蹄子差点打滑。
lines.en: Shoved aside, my hooves nearly slipped out.

lines.zh: 别推我的后腿，我会往前冲。
lines.en: Do not push my hind legs; I will lurch forward.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，像一摞饼。
lines.en: Jammed together, we look like stacked biscuits.

lines.zh: 我身上没有棱角，撞着不疼。
lines.en: I have no sharp corners, so bumping me is painless.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就有地方站了。
lines.en: You step back half a pace and I have room.

lines.zh: 我的角还没长成，别怕。
lines.en: My horns have not grown in yet; do not worry.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我皮很厚。
lines.en: One bump is fine; my hide is quite thick.

lines.zh: 我们别挤了，草够大家吃。
lines.en: Let us stop shoving; there is grass for all.

lines.zh: 牛的事，总是很安静。
lines.en: The business of cows is always very quiet.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We stand side by side and neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 她身上的颜色比我深一点。
lines.en: Her coat is a shade darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我用头顶轻轻碰她一下。
lines.en: I bump her gently with the top of my head.

lines.zh: 我们会在草最厚的地方待着。
lines.en: We stay where the grass grows thickest.

lines.zh: 小牛出生时，颜色就很深。
lines.en: The calf is born already deep in color.

lines.zh: 别围观，我们会走开的。
lines.en: Do not crowd around us; we will walk off.

lines.zh: 两只牛靠在一起，草地都暖和了。
lines.en: Two cows together make the whole meadow warmer.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子将来也会掉皮革。
lines.en: Our children will drop leather one day too.

lines.zh: 这种事，一年也就一两回。
lines.en: This happens only once or twice a year.

lines.zh: 地上有块草，我用嘴叼起来。
lines.en: There is grass on the ground; I take it up.

lines.zh: 我低头捡东西，动作很慢。
lines.en: I lower my head to pick things up slowly.

lines.zh: 这块麦子是谁掉的？
lines.en: Whose wheat fell on the ground here?

lines.zh: 我不吃别的，只想捡草。
lines.en: I eat nothing else; I only gather grass.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷起来，送进嘴里。
lines.en: I curl my tongue around it and eat.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，归牛群。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to the herd.

lines.zh: 我捡了一小把，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I picked up a small bunch and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 那块布头没用，我放下了。
lines.en: That scrap of cloth is useless; I drop it.

lines.zh: 低头时，我的影子盖住了草。
lines.en: Bending down, my shadow covers the grass.

lines.zh: 麦子掉在地上，我低头捡。
lines.en: Wheat fell on the ground, so I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我注意到你，是因为你在挥手。
lines.en: I noticed you because you were waving.

lines.zh: 那边有一片新草地，我看见了。
lines.en: There is fresh grass over there, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，是因为你拿着草。
lines.en: I walk toward you because you hold grass.

lines.zh: 你进了我的牧场，我抬起头。
lines.en: You entered my pasture, so I raise my head.

lines.zh: 远处有牛群，我要走过去。
lines.en: The herd is far off, and I mean to join it.

lines.zh: 我闻到了水的味道。
lines.en: I have caught the smell of water nearby.

lines.zh: 有个东西在草丛里动。
lines.en: Something is moving around in the tall grass.

lines.zh: 我盯住那块最绿的草。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on the greenest patch.

lines.zh: 你走得快，我也加快了脚步。
lines.en: You walked faster, so I quickened my pace.

lines.zh: 我的目标很简单，就是那片草。
lines.en: My goal is simple, and it is that grass.

lines.zh: 我一边嚼，一边看着你。
lines.en: I watch you while continuing to chew.

lines.zh: 你站得太久了，我有点好奇。
lines.en: You have stood there long, and I am curious.

lines.zh: 我转了个方向，继续盯着。
lines.en: I turn a little and keep on staring.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，只是不太敢靠近。
lines.en: I mean no harm; I am just wary of approaching.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的头就抬起来。
lines.en: When you move, my head comes up.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离，刚好够我跑。
lines.en: The gap between us is just enough to run.

lines.zh: 我把重心放在前腿上，随时能动。
lines.en: I lean on my front legs, ready to go.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，我一直看着。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on what is in your hands.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是安静地盯着。
lines.en: I do not moo; I only stare quietly.

lines.zh: 别突然跑，我会跟着跑的。
lines.en: Do not bolt suddenly; I will run after you.

lines.zh: 我顶你一下，用的是额头。
lines.en: I butt you once, using my forehead.

lines.zh: 牛也会生气，只是不常。
lines.en: Cows get angry too, just not often.

lines.zh: 你拉我的尾巴，这就过分了。
lines.en: You pulled my tail, and that crossed a line.

lines.zh: 我抬起前蹄，往前一踏。
lines.en: I lift a front hoof and stomp forward.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，是警告。
lines.en: This one is not heavy; it is a warning.

lines.zh: 我顶了一下，只是警告。
lines.en: That headbutt was only a warning.

lines.zh: 我冲过来时，草地都在抖。
lines.en: When I charge, the whole meadow shakes.

lines.zh: 十点生命，我也会拼命。
lines.en: Even with ten health, I will still fight.

lines.zh: 别抓我的角，那里最敏感。
lines.en: Do not grab my horns; they are the tenderest spot.

lines.zh: 我只顶一下，然后回去吃草。
lines.en: I butt once, then go back to eating grass.

lines.zh: 我出生在平原，草很高。
lines.en: I was born on the plains where grass runs high.

lines.zh: 天一亮，我就在这片草上站着了。
lines.en: At first light I was already standing in this grass.

lines.zh: 牛群在附近，我跟着它们走。
lines.en: The herd is nearby, and I follow along.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，落下几粒草屑。
lines.en: I shook myself and a few grass bits fell.

lines.zh: 从刷怪蛋里出来，世界很亮。
lines.en: Out of a spawn egg, the world is very bright.

lines.zh: 我第一次抬头，看见了一整片天。
lines.en: I raised my head and saw the whole sky.

lines.zh: 这块草地闻起来是新的。
lines.en: This patch of grass smells entirely new.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，就开始找草。
lines.en: The moment I stood, I began looking for grass.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和泥土很配。
lines.en: My coloring goes well with the bare dirt.

lines.zh: 又一头牛出生了，草原不缺牛。
lines.en: Another cow is born; the plains have plenty.

lines.zh: 火碰到毛，焦味和甜味混在一起。
lines.en: Fire meets my coat, and burnt meets sweet.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，草屑满身。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope covered in grass bits.

lines.zh: 河底的泥把我的蹄子吸住了。
lines.en: The river mud sucks at my hooves.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，四蹄朝上。
lines.en: The blast flipped me over, all four hooves up.

lines.zh: 箭射进我的侧腹，很深。
lines.en: An arrow sank deep into my flank.

lines.zh: 那股魔力让我的毛竖起来。
lines.en: That magic made every hair on me stand up.

lines.zh: 这片草被吃光了，我很饿。
lines.en: This patch is eaten bare, and I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷电打在我背上，毛全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and singed my coat.

lines.zh: 我一直在掉，蹄子下什么都没有。
lines.en: I keep falling, with nothing under my hooves.
